test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Five people, Zunaid, Riya, Hema. Indu and Jagan, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Zunaid is sitting second to the left of Indu. Hema is sitting second to the right of Riya. Jagan is not an immediate neighbour of Zunaid.

Who is sitting third to the right of Riya?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Five people, Zunaid, Riya, Hema, Indu, and Jagan are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cba096b2c22fc0b34ebf24b5e6837a11546f4a8ef8da8c0b602513fedd7dbd9.png] 

 
• Zunaid is sitting second to the left of Indu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9daf5b606e87bb96d0fa84bbef06ce2d584b2e0ba9a831f62df32fe466b736d9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df1953d30b3b33e7b00f58fa4f6e7708abe502534f0e78e6c07bb544f354fb19.png] 

 
• Hema is sitting second to the right of Riya.

Case I:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ce237a921a0f92851ad6c1e4f601da99e984b212011c3b2f515cca3aa04d23d.png] 

Case II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60bd1b585305a078df359f357d39ffa2e7136abe1dff9ee0a588291b8ec86b73.png] 

 
• Jagan is not an immediate neighbour of Zunaid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc71bec404d4d9bafaf73e2334ec475a48e18fe984e78406eb1c553a5ab9ff1a.png] 

So, **Indu** is sitting third right to **Riya.**

Hence, **the correct answer is 'Indu'.**
